reviews.title: Review of the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse
reviews.comment: I recently purchased the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse from Amazon, and I couldn’t be happier with my choice. This mouse has exceeded my expectations in terms of quality, performance, and ergonomics. Exceptional Quality The build quality of the Basilisk V3 Pro is outstanding. It feels solid and well-constructed, which is essential for a gaming mouse that’s meant to endure hours of use. The materials used are top-notch, providing a premium feel that enhances the overall experience. Ergonomics One of the standout features of this mouse is its ergonomic design. It fits perfectly in my hand, making long gaming sessions comfortable. The shape and grip are well thought out, allowing for precise movements without causing fatigue. Performance I’ve been using this mouse for some time now, and I’ve encountered no issues with response time. The tracking is incredibly accurate, which is crucial for competitive gaming. I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gameplay, thanks to the reliable performance of this mouse. Battery Life The battery life is impressive as well. Depending on my usage, it lasts up to two days or even three, which is fantastic for a wireless device. I appreciate not having to constantly recharge it, allowing me to focus on my gaming sessions. Features and Software The Basilisk V3 Pro comes packed with features that enhance its functionality. I downloaded the Razer software, which was straightforward and user-friendly. Customizing settings and adjusting performance options is a breeze, allowing me to tailor the mouse to my preferences. Final Thoughts Overall, the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse is a quality investment for any gamer. With its excellent ergonomics, reliable performance, and impressive battery life, it has become an indispensable part of my gaming setup. I highly recommend this mouse to anyone looking for a high-performance gaming accessory!
reviews.author: Jason Youngblood

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: Definitely recommend this mouse it has supper fast response time and no input delay despite the wireless connection. Supper smooth click feed back. Tactile wheel and it has a convenient button to make the scroll wheel not clicky and just a free spin. And if I don't want to use it wirelessly the mouse can be used wired.  And I always leave the mouse on and after a few minutes the mouse will go to sleep and not use power almost like a standby phase definitely worth the price
reviews.author: carlos

reviews.title: One of the best gaming mice I've ever used
reviews.comment: I had a really old Logitech mouse and was overdue for an upgrade. I game a lot and have bigger hands, so I spent some time researching, trying to find something that wouldn't result in cramps or awkward grips. I know the fit comes down to grip style, but I never gave it much thought before this purchase. I noticed that my hand very naturally met the form of the mouse, and it stays comfortable to use throughout the day. I will work for a full 8 hours and then spend a few hours in the evening gaming, and it just feels great. I use it with the wireless charging hub, and I have no issues with latency or lag. The charge will last for multiple days if I forget to set it on the charging dock overnight. The mouse feels sturdy and firm with a good weight to it. Never too heavy or cumbersome. The wheel scroll is clean and it has just the right amount of extra buttons for productivity and gaming macros. 100% reccomend.
reviews.author: Christian J. Estrada

reviews.title: Nice mouse for most users.
reviews.comment: Finding a mouse that will work well without loading down the computer with excess software can be a challenge. I replaced my logi gaming mouse with this one so I could offload the logi software. I does mouse things well. I can use this mouse for extended periods in comfort. I don't play competitive PVP games and have noticed no lag or response times issues in any of the games I do play. I can't say much about using it wireless for competitive shooters. PROS: ergonomic enough, good response time with no noticeable lag in wireless mode CONS: battery life is acceptable, not great. I do recommend this mouse. Good value and I would buy it again.
reviews.author: Topwatch

reviews.title: Get it if its what you're looking for.
reviews.comment: I love it. I don't prefer very light mice, i find the weight to be perfect for me. I have the non 35k version too and its held up, and the batteries do last pretty long on the basilisks mice. Clicks are good. Scroll wheel is somewhat gimmicky and usless, but the tilt wheel comes in handy for gaming. Skates are ok, not the best for the price, but its not an issue. The phantom white looks nice. I seen other users have issues with the rubber grips over time getting smashed in, but my non k model has held up good I dont squeeze them to d**th though. Haven't had the phantom white long enough to see.  Wireless works flawless so far, i don't expect problems with any basilisks mice.
